title: The Open Road
author: Rootless Adventure Company
description: In The Open Road Podcast, Megan, also known as Rootless Adventure Company, share stories and practical tips to help you live a fulfilling life that prioritizes your health, happiness, and adventurous bucket list. Listen as she explores the intersection of full-time travel and creative entrepreneurship from nearly a decade on the road as a solo female traveler. Join us every week for solo episodes and conversations with fellow travelers/entrepreneurs who have turned their dreams into reality and make every moment of this beautiful life count!
